The '''signature scent synthesizer''' manufactured by [[Paradour Enterprises]] was a specialized device capable of producing highly specialized [[Perfume/Legends|perfumes]] and [[Cologne]].<ref name="GFT" />

==Characteristics==
A highly specialized combination synthesizer and replicator, the scent synthesizer used advanced biochemical extraction to replicate any desired fragrance.<ref name="GFT" /> The scent synthesizer had an internal library of thousands of stock fragrances, and a user could mix and match - storing up to a million custom creations in the unit's memory for quick and easy recall.<ref name="GFT" />

The scent synthesizer could also be used to create pheromonal additives and biological ingredients that could potentially induce exceptionally strong effects in other sentients.<ref name="GFT" /> Enterprising individuals with backgrounds in chemistry were capable of using scent synthesizers to concoct all kinds of substances with a number of psychological and physiological effects.<ref name="GFT" />
